title: Existential and Universal Length Step
statement: Let $m$ be a natural number and $Q$ a property of Boolean strings. If the Boolean parameter is true, the step holds exactly when some Boolean string of length $m$ satisfies $Q$; if it is false, the step holds exactly when every Boolean string of length $m$ satisfies $Q$.
